high_level_description: The image is a screenshot of an article from "The Hindu" newspaper website. The headline reads: "Pakistan has unleashed a disinformation offensive, says govt." Below the headline, there is a brief article discussing a statement by India's director-general of air operations, Air Marshal A.K. Bharti. The article mentions that Bharti would not comment on specific details about losses but acknowledged that "losses are a part of combat" and that all Indian Air Force pilots were "back home.
